raw_text:
Microsoft Corporation — Software Engineer 
Role Category: SDE 
  Hyderabad, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹28,00,000 CTC   Joining bonus, annual performance bonus, stock 
awards (RSUs) 
Role Overview 
Join a team building scalable software across Microsoft products such as Azure, Microsoft 
365, and Windows. You'll own features end to end, from design through production. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable software components 
• Participate in Agile ceremonies and design reviews with your team 
• Write clean, efficient code and hold a high bar in code review 
• Ensure reliability, security, and performance of the systems you own 
• Work cross-functionally with PM and design to refine requirements 
What We're Looking For 
• Strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals — hash maps, trees, and 
complexity analysis, applied confidently under time pressure 
• Practical coding skills — pattern matching, interval problems, and writing code that 
performs well on large inputs 
• Working knowledge of operating systems (process scheduling, virtual memory, 
concurrency primitives) and core networking (REST APIs, timeouts, request lifecycle) 
• Ability to design at the system level — sketch a cloud-based storage or notification 
service and reason about scalability and fault tolerance 
• Understanding of object-oriented design and SOLID principles, and how to design 
software that's easy to extend 
• Software engineering maturity — clean code habits, a real testing strategy, and 
comfort talking about technical debt honestly 
• Strong communication — able to describe a hard problem you solved and how you 
collaborate across teams 
Nice to Have 
Exposure to cloud infrastructure (Azure or similar); contributions to a shared codebase in a 
team setting. 
Benefits 
Comprehensive health insurance, RSUs, flexible work arrangements, learning and 
certification budget, wellness programs.

raw_text:
Oracle Financial Services Software Limited — Application Support 
Analyst 
Role Category: Support / Operations 
  Bengaluru / Chennai, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹4,50,000 CTC   Shift allowance and annual 
performance bonus 
Role Overview 
Provide L2/L3 application support for Oracle Financial Services products used by global 
banking clients — a support and troubleshooting role with real client-facing responsibility, not 
a pure development role. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents raised by banking clients within SLA 
• Query production databases to diagnose issues 
• Coordinate with development teams on escalations that require a code fix 
• Monitor logs and batch/real-time processes to catch issues early 
• Communicate clearly and calmly with clients during incidents 
What We're Looking For 
• Comfort with basic SQL — simple SELECT/WHERE queries and an understanding of 
primary keys 
• Operating systems and Linux fundamentals — basic command-line usage, what a log 
file is, batch vs. real-time processing 
• Basic networking knowledge — what an IP address is, client-server architecture 
fundamentals, and what “latency” means in practice 
• Strong quantitative and logical reasoning — data interpretation from tables, arithmetic, 
and structured problem-solving 
• Excellent communication skills — able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical 
client, stay calm during an escalation, and document what happened clearly 
• Willingness to work in shifts and directly support global clients 
Nice to Have 
Prior exposure to a ticketing/incident system; coursework in networking or systems 
administration. 
Benefits 
Medical insurance, night shift allowance, transport facility, paid leaves.

Oracle Financial Services Software Limited — Associate Software 
Engineer 
Role Category: SDE 
  Bengaluru / Mumbai, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹5,50,000 CTC   Annual performance bonus based on 
individual and team performance 
Role Overview 
Join the team building and maintaining enterprise-grade banking and financial services 
products such as FLEXCUBE and OBDX, used by banks globally. You'll work across 
development, customization, and support in an Agile environment. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Develop, customize, and maintain modules within our banking product suite 
• Write and debug code, and interact directly with relational databases 
• Perform unit testing and collaborate closely with QA 
• Participate in Agile ceremonies and coordinate with product teams 
• Document your work clearly for future maintainers 
What We're Looking For 
• Solid programming fundamentals — able to read and predict the output of code, and 
solve basic string/array manipulation problems confidently 
• Practical SQL knowledge — correct SELECT/WHERE syntax, understanding of 
DELETE vs. TRUNCATE, and comfort writing simple queries against a relational 
schema 
• Core data structures knowledge — arrays vs. linked lists, when to use a stack or a 
queue, and basic algorithmic problem-solving 
• Object-oriented programming fundamentals — inheritance, polymorphism, abstract 
classes vs. interfaces, explained with real examples 
• Operating systems basics — what a process is, fundamentals of multithreading and 
memory management 
• Strong quantitative aptitude — time-and-work, ratios, percentages, and logical/seating-
arrangement style reasoning 
• Clear communication and a collaborative attitude — comfortable explaining your final-
year project and working under deadline pressure 
• Awareness of the software development lifecycle and the difference between Agile and 
Waterfall, and why documentation matters 
Nice to Have 
Coursework or a project in banking/financial systems; willingness to work in shifts or from 
client locations. 
Benefits 
Health insurance, provident fund, gratuity, learning and certification programs, subsidized 
meals.
